origin: Explicit follow-up against the existing benchmarks/machsuite_u32/gemm_original.c reference; not a new independent original algorithm
transformation: Tile GEMM columns by two with local accumulators

assumptions: 32-bit int and unsigned int; uint32_t is unsigned int
All array parameters are valid, separately allocated, and nonoverlapping
Functional equality at function completion; no cycle-level RTL guarantee
verification.normalization: Z3 modular sum-of-monomials simplification of output differences
